training_method.working_sets: All working sets normally go to failure. Usually 2 working sets per exercise; if time permits and the user opts for 3, use 3 for all exercises in that workout.
training_method.rep_rule: Choose the heaviest practical load that permits at least 10 clean reps; continue beyond 10 until failure. Ten is a minimum, not a cap.
training_method.failure_definition: Stop when another clean concentric repetition cannot be completed. For RDL and other technically sensitive free-weight movements, stop at technical failure before form degrades.
training_method.next_session_load_rule: If failure occurs above 10 reps, assess the smallest practical load increase. If failure occurs below 10, hold or reduce. At 10 reps, hold unless broader performance supports an increase.
training_method.logging: Record actual load and reps per set. Track load PRs and rep PRs separately. Do not assign RIR by default.
training_method.exercise_order: Prioritize the day's main/heaviest compound lifts early while fresh, after the user's established warm-up. This reflects the user's strength-biased hypertrophy preference.

performance_prs.tracking_rule: Track weight PR and rep PR separately. For lifting movements, benchmark the heaviest load that reaches at least 10 clean reps to failure, and best rep count at each exact load. Do not infer estimated 1RM.
